page.notes: Printed "vanâ" and "gratiâ" carry a mark over the a that I read as a left-out n, so I wrote vanā and gratiā; this is doubtful. The running head is set with spaced capitals, V O E T, and is given as P. VOET. The small mark between "que" and "certi" is a speck, not a printed sign. A small dash at the very bottom left edge is not text and is left out.
